body.label: Target
body.html: Self and up to two willing allies within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Each target reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 and gains +1 Harmony against the next attack targeting it until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Each ally may move 1 unit toward you.
One target reduces that Damage by 1 more.

rider.title: Rite - Ward
rider.html: Rite, 2 Echoes: anchor a visible point within 3 units. Trigger: a willing creature within 1 unit would be pushed or pulled. Echo: reduce that movement by 2 units.
